{"id":1781612541,"question_id":3997,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"9 months, 4 weeks","timestamp":1758741140,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"9 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1781612541/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximize Sum of At Most K Distinct Elements","memory":"32.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> maxKDistinct(vector<int>& nums, int k) {\n        unordered_set<int>st;\n        for(auto num : nums)\n        {\n            st.insert(num);\n        }\n\n        vector<int>unique(st.begin() , st.end());\n        sort(rbegin(unique) , rend(unique));\n        vector<int>ans;\n\n        int count = 0;\n        for(auto num: unique)\n        {\n            if(count == k) break;\n            ans.push_back(num);\n            count++;\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximize-sum-of-at-most-k-distinct-elements","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":848}
